categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly configured with sitemap reference
Vercel CDN caching with Brotli compression
Comprehensive meta tags (OG, Twitter, canonical, keywords)

findings.title: Duplicate robots.txt files
findings.description: Both public/robots.txt and src/app/robots.ts exist. Next.js dynamic route overrides the static file.
findings.recommendation: Remove public/robots.txt since src/app/robots.ts is the active route.

findings.title: robots.txt missing AI crawler directives
findings.description: No explicit rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit allow rules for AI crawlers to robots.ts.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: Only HSTS is set. Missing CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options headers.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers in next.config.ts headers configuration.

findings.title: generator meta tag exposes framework
findings.description: generator: Next.js reveals framework version.
findings.recommendation: Remove generator meta tag if preferred, though generally acceptable.

findings.title: No Bing Webmaster verification
findings.description: Google is verified but no msvalidate.01 meta tag for Bing.
findings.recommendation: Add Bing verification meta tag for Bing Copilot visibility.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 8 blog posts with genuine technical depth
Clear content strategy spanning web dev, AI, automation
Reading time displayed on blog posts
MDX content with language-tagged code blocks

findings.title: No visible author byline on blog posts
findings.description: Blog post header shows date and reading time but no author name. Author only in JSON-LD and meta tags.
findings.recommendation: Add visible byline to blog post header template.

findings.title: Blog posts lack modifiedDate field
findings.description: Both datePublished and dateModified use the same post.date value.
findings.recommendation: Add modifiedDate field to BlogPost type and use it for JSON-LD dateModified.

findings.title: Hello World post is thin content
findings.description: Introductory first post with minimal depth dilutes overall content quality.
findings.recommendation: Expand the post or add noindex if it remains brief.

findings.title: Project descriptions are single sentences
findings.description: All project descriptions are 1 sentence. 4 of 9 projects have inactive # links.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 sentence descriptions and GitHub links for inactive projects.

findings.title: No external source citations in blog posts
findings.description: Blog posts are how-to guides without cited statistics or external references.
findings.recommendation: Add authoritative source links to strengthen E-E-A-T.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Meta descriptions present on all pages
Proper heading structure in blog posts (H1→H2→H3)
Blog Table of Contents (desktop and mobile)

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Person schema with @id and sameAs links

findings.title: BlogPosting publisher is Person, not Organization
findings.description: Google Article rich results require publisher as Organization with logo.
findings.recommendation: Create Organization schema and use as publisher in blog JsonLd.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList is flat navigation map
findings.description: Lists all 4 top-level pages as positions 1-4, not a per-page breadcrumb trail.
findings.recommendation: Replace with per-page BreadcrumbList components in each route.

findings.title: SearchAction target uses verbose EntryPoint shape
findings.description: Uses EntryPoint object instead of plain string for target.
findings.recommendation: Simplify target to plain URL string.

findings.title: Person @id cross-document reference on blog pages
findings.description: Blog pages reference #person defined on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Include full @graph on blog pages or use inline-only Person definition.

findings.title: dateModified equals datePublished for all posts
findings.description: Both use post.date. Misleading for edited posts.
findings.recommendation: Add modifiedDate to BlogPost type.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Vercel CDN with cache HIT confirmed

findings.title: Framer Motion animations add JavaScript weight
findings.description: Homepage uses framer-motion for multiple animations.
findings.recommendation: Consider CSS animations for simple effects to reduce bundle size.

findings.title: TypeIt-react library for typing effect
findings.description: Client-side dependency for cosmetic typing animation.
findings.recommendation: Consider CSS-based typing animation to eliminate dependency.

findings.title: Three analytics scripts loaded in head
findings.description: GTM + GA + Umami each add DNS lookup, JS download, and execution time.
findings.recommendation: Consider consolidating to one analytics solution.

findings.title: No font preloading detected
findings.description: Custom fonts may not be preloaded, potentially affecting LCP.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel=preload as=font> for custom fonts if not system fonts.
